edges.reason: callerIsUser modifier on claimToken restricts callers via tx.origin == msg.sender, bypassable by contracts
callerIsUser modifier on claimTokens uses tx.origin for the caller check
claimStarted modifier gates claimToken on block.timestamp versus startClaimDate
claimStarted modifier gates claimTokens on block.timestamp versus startClaimDate
msg.sender indexes claimedTokensPerWallet and is the mint recipient in claimToken
msg.sender indexes claimedTokensPerWallet and is the mint recipient in claimTokens
msg.sender is included in the pseudo-random seed of _getRandomNumber
claimToken requires msg.value >= claimPrice
claimTokens requires msg.value >= claimPrice * amount
claimToken enforces claimedTokensPerWallet[msg.sender] < maxClaimsPerWallet
claimTokens enforces claimedTokensPerWallet[msg.sender] + amount <= maxClaimsPerWallet
claimToken requires availableTokens.length > 0 before drawing a token
claimTokens requires availableTokens.length >= amount, the pool is decremented per draw
totalMintedTokens++ in claimToken is an unchecked-count style increment
totalMintedTokens += amount in claimTokens accumulates user-controlled amount
claimToken increments claimedTokensPerWallet[msg.sender]
claimTokens adds amount to claimedTokensPerWallet[msg.sender]
claimToken obtains the token id to mint from getTokenToBeClaimed
claimToken calls _mint for the claimed token
claimTokens calls getTokenToBeClaimed for each token in the loop
claimTokens calls _batchMint with the collected tokenIds
reserveDjens requires availableTokens.length >= 80
reserveDjens checks totalReserved < resDjens before reserving
totalReserved += 80 in reserveDjens
totalMintedTokens += 80 in reserveDjens
reserveDjens builds the token id list via getTokenToBeClaimed
reserveDjens batch mints the reserved tokens
reserveDjens allocates and fills the tokenIds array
getTokenToBeClaimed calls _getRandomNumber with the pool length
getTokenToBeClaimed stores the returned index in the random local
getTokenToBeClaimed converts the picked element into the tokenId local
_getRandomNumber derives its output from a keccak hash of predictable block and caller values
_mint increments _balances[to]
_mint writes _owners[tokenId] = to
_batchMint adds tokenIds.length to _balances[to]
_batchMint sets _owners for each token in the loop
_transfer decrements and increments _balances entries
_transfer updates _owners[tokenId]
_burn decrements _balances[owner]
_burn deletes _owners[tokenId]
_checkOnERC721Received calls external receiver onERC721Received, giving control to an untrusted contract
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() as the operator argument to the receiver
withdraw performs an external ether transfer to each collaborator
withdraw computes the collaborator share through mulScale
withdraw caches address(this).balance in the totalBalance local
withdraw iterates the collaborators array for addresses and cuts
withdraw uses basisPoints as the mulScale scale factor
addCollaborators pushes each element of _collaborators into the collaborators array
addCollaborators accumulates cuts in the totalCut local
addCollaborators requires totalCut == basisPoints
addAvailableTokens pushes every id in the range into availableTokens
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and rewrites the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and sets _owner to the zero address
setStartClaimDate is onlyOwner and writes startClaimDate, which controls claim availability
setClaimPrice is onlyOwner and writes claimPrice, which controls payability of claims
